facts.business: Melstar Information Technologies Limited is an IT company that emerged from corporate insolvency and is resuming operations with subsidiaries in aviation tech and fintech.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to going concern basis preparation pending business licenses and clearances; key audit matters include allowance for credit losses and investment impairment assessment

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty pending business licenses and clearances
Pending listing and trading approval from stock exchanges for shares allotted under resolution plan
Historical losses and negative net worth
Credit losses on trade receivables requiring significant judgment
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions up to Rs. 150 crore each with Mindsweep Ideas Pvt Ltd (ultimate holding company) and Shivasons Solutions India Pvt Ltd (holding company) for intercorporate loans and business transactions, and Rs. 25 lakh for director remuneration to Tarun Kashyap for FY 2026-27
